system.description:
You walk between worlds — the living and the spirit, the present and the ancestral. Where Druids tend the natural world, Shamans negotiate with what lies beneath and beyond it.

  • Spirit Sight: Advantage on checks to perceive, communicate with, or identify spirits, ancestors, and extraplanar entities of natural origin. Once per day, ask the spirits one yes/no question about the immediate area or a creature nearby — the answer comes as an impression, not words.
  • Ancestor's Fury: Once per encounter, call on ancestral power — your next spell or attack made while in Wild Shape deals an additional 1d8 damage of any type you choose.
